label: Town of Concord
header:
# Town of Concord municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Concord Selectboard members: Richard Casavant, James Gochie, Denis Lamadeleine (Vice Chair), George Morehouse, and Jason Payeur (Chair).

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify the March 3, 2026 re-election of James Gochie (2-year term) and Richard Casavant (3-year term).

Town of Concord, 'Town of Concord Report 2025' (annual report archive posted on the town's official website, concordvt.us): 'Elected Town Officials as of December 31, 2025' lists the board before the 2026 meeting as Payeur, Lamadeleine, Morehouse, Chris Fournier, and Bill Humphrey; Fournier and Humphrey rotated off at the 2026 meeting.

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify Chris Fournier's election as Town Moderator for a 1-year term on March 3, 2026 (116 votes).

Town of Concord, 'Town of Concord Report 2025' (annual report archive posted on the town's official website, concordvt.us): 'Elected Town Officials as of December 31, 2025' lists Chris Fournier as Moderator.

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify Linda A. Blakslee's re-election as Town Clerk for a 3-year term on March 3, 2026.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Linda A. Blakslee as Town Clerk of Concord.

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify Audra Girouard's re-election as Town Treasurer for a 3-year term on March 3, 2026. The town collects its taxes by its Treasurer (warning Article 2), so no separate collector office exists.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Audra Girouard as Town Treasurer of Concord.

Town of Concord, 'Town of Concord Report 2025' (annual report archive posted on the town's official website, concordvt.us): 'Elected Town Officials as of December 31, 2025' lists three Auditors: Donna Berry (term expiring 2026), Laura Goldshein (remainder of a term expiring 2027), and Theresa Hovey (term expiring 2028).

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify Donna Berry's re-election as Auditor for a 3-year term on March 3, 2026 (157 votes).

Town of Concord, 'Town of Concord Report 2025' (annual report archive posted on the town's official website, concordvt.us): 'Elected Town Officials as of December 31, 2025' lists five Library Trustees on 5-year terms: Jill Abetti (expiring 2026), Mary Gochie (remainder, 2028), Nancy LaPotin (2029), Elaine Stasny (remainder, 2027), and Eileen Wilson (2028).

Town of Concord, March 3, 2026 Annual Town Meeting results (certified tally sheets of Town Clerk Linda A. Blakslee, posted on concordvt.us): certify the March 3, 2026 election of Jill Abetti (5-year term, 162 votes) and Mary Gochie (remainder of a 5-year term to 2028, 176 votes).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Concord justices of the peace: Danielle Balch, Linda Blakslee, Paula Christopher, Christopher Fournier, and Arlene Hovey.

Town of Concord, 'Town of Concord Report 2025' (annual report archive posted on the town's official website, concordvt.us): 'Elected Town Officials as of December 31, 2025' lists the same five justices of the peace (terms expiring February 2027).
